# 🟣 BUSINESS COMMAND CENTER — Repository Work Routing

Inspect existing structure first. Reuse existing modules; never create duplicate architecture. Route product code to existing source folders, tests to existing test conventions, database changes to schema/migrations, CI/deployment to `.github/workflows/` or existing deployment folders, operational records to `docs/operations/`, architecture decisions to `docs/architecture/`, and business rules to `docs/business/`. Do not leave temporary investigation files at repository root. Maintain one authoritative source for every config, policy and workflow. Diagnose blockers, recover, verify and continue without repeated approval. Stop only for destructive/paid actions, missing credentials/permissions or legal consent. Report only verified success or the exact blocker. Completion requires relevant build/tests/CI and deployment health verification where applicable.
